notes.title: Frontier Legends – Demo Update
notes.notes:
Howdy pioneers! 🌵

We’ve got a brand-new update for the Frontier Legends demo bringing more life to your towns, deeper building options, and a whole host of fixes that smooth out your adventures on the frontier. This update introduces worker NPCs and the foundations of town management, as well as new items and building improvements. We’ve also tackled a long list of pesky bugs (especially around horses 🐎) to make your journey more stable and enjoyable.



🆕 Additions

Miners Camp has been added.

Nails are now available, allowing you to build bigger and stronger buildings.

Town NPCs (first stage) – NPCs now start working in town. Later updates will expand them to give quests and share information when interacted with.

Worker NPC system – Hire workers by interacting with worker buildings. Different quality workers can be hired, managed, and tracked through their respective buildings. Hired workers will walk from the train station to their assigned building. (In the next update, workers will require wages and housing to stay happy and productive!)

🔧 Fixes & Improvements

Fixed: Dying on a horse prevented riding it again immediately after respawn.

Fixed: Horses that die while being ridden no longer keep running forward.

Fixed: Teleporting through house walls when dismounting a horse.

Fixed: Opening a chest during the mounting sequence locked the camera.

Fixed: Inventory bug where saddles and items could disappear under certain conditions.

Fixed: Mounting while moving caused desync, appearing on “nothing” before teleporting onto the horse.

Fixed: Saddle inventory exploit where invisible slots were created.

Fixed: Range values not updating correctly.

Fixed: Horse UI only showing 100/100 HP (now reflects correct health, e.g., 300 HP).

Fixed: Loading an autosave while dead created a new character and erased levels/stat points.

Fixed: Furnace crafting no longer requires a campfire.

Fixed: Houses not saving their building stages – now houses are completed when placed down.


That’s all for this round, pioneers! Be sure to wishlist Frontier Legends to stay up to date on future updates, new features, and the road to Early Access.

notes.title: Demo Update – Just in Time for Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to release this new update to the demo ahead of our Kickstarter launch on April 23rd! Make sure to follow us there to get all the details on backer rewards and exclusive content.

This update focuses on bug fixes and introduces several new systems to enhance your gameplay experience:


 First Quest Added! Head to the Hunter’s Camp to experience the new quest system. More quests will be added soon!
 Horse Improvements: Fixed speed and behavior bugs + added immersive sound effects.
 Swimming Enabled: You can now swim in lakes and rivers—dive in!
 Resource Tweaks: Reduced decay time for meat and other consumables.
 Bison Loot Buff: Bison now drop more resources when harvested.
 Hunter’s Merchant: Sell hides and mob loot for coin and trade.
 Loot Containers: Randomly spawning containers across the world with randomized loot.
 MetaHuman Player Character: We've upgraded the player model to MetaHuman in preparation for the future Character Creation System.
 Furniture Placement Fix: Now limited to indoor areas only.
 New Camp Blueprint: Includes a campfire and a small storage container.
 Miner's Hut Added: Spawns a miner NPC who automatically gathers stone for you.
 NPC Pathfinding Improved: Less getting stuck! NPCs now reset if harvesting a missing resource.


We can’t wait to hear what you think—join us on social media and let us know how you're enjoying the latest update!
